title: SAE Interprets MoE: Sparse AutoEncoders Reveal That MoE Experts Exhibit Human-Interpretable Fine-Grained Specialization
abstract: arXiv:2611.08089v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a few of many experts, yet what an individual expert is responsible for remains unsettled. Existing analyses count how often an expert is selected on domain-labeled corpora, an instrument that fixes the taxonomy in advance, stays coarse, and records selection rather than contribution. We instead study specialization in feature space by training a sparse autoencoder (SAE) on the output of an MoE layer. Since this output is a router-weighted sum of expert outputs and the SAE encoder is affine, the pre-activation of every latent decomposes exactly over the experts. Aggregated over a corpus, this gives each expert a dominant set of latents whose activation it principally drives. On layers 4, 30 and 46 of Qwen3-30B-A3B, contribution is far more concentrated than gating, most latents have only one or two dominators, and the overlap between dominant sets concentrates on a few expert pairs. translated_title: SAE 解读 MoE：稀疏自编码器揭示 MoE 专家表现出人类可解释的细粒度专业化
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型将每个 token 路由到众多专家中的少数几个，然而单个专家究竟负责什么仍悬而未决。现有分析通过在带有领域标签的语料库上统计专家被选中的频率来研究专家分工，这种方法预先固定了分类体系、粒度粗糙，且记录的是“被选择”而非“实际贡献”。我们转而在特征空间中研究专家专业化：在 MoE 层的输出上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）。由于该输出是各专家输出的路由器加权求和，而 SAE 编码器是仿射变换，因此每个潜变量的预激活值可以精确地分解到各个专家上。在语料库上聚合后，这为每个专家得到一组主导潜变量，其激活主要由该专家驱动。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 模型的第 4、30 和 46 层上，研究发现专家的贡献远比门控分布更集中，大多数潜变量仅由一个或两个专家主导，且主导集合之间的重叠集中在少数专家对上。
tldr: 该论文通过在 MoE 层输出上训练稀疏自编码器，利用其仿射结构将每个潜变量的激活精确分解到各专家，从而揭示出 MoE 专家具有比门控选择统计所能体现的更集中、且人类可解释的细粒度专业化分工。
en_tdlr: By training a sparse autoencoder on MoE layer outputs and exploiting its affine structure to exactly decompose each latent's activation across experts, this work reveals that MoE experts exhibit human-interpretable, fine-grained specialization that is far more concentrated than what routing statistics alone can show.
